About the position

Are you ambitious, commercially minded, and eager to take the next step in your career within the intersection of strategy, branding, sales and marketing?

As a Consultant/Senior Consultant in Sunrise’s Insights & Strategy team, you’ll work with ambitious Danish and international companies to turn customer, market, and business insights into strategic direction and creative solutions with commercial impact.

Your main objective will be to create strong market positions for our clients and accelerate their business growth by helping them navigate transitions across three critical domains: Brand Transition, Marketing Transition, and Sales Transition. Especially within complex business-to-business (B2B) environments. This requires a combination of thorough analysis, insight-driven strategy, commercial thinking, and an understanding of how strategy translates into creative execution or actionable initiatives.

You will take an active role throughout our projects – from research and analysis to developing strategic recommendations, preparing and participating in client workshops, and translating strategy into clear briefs and direction for our creative and activation specialists.

We are looking for someone with 2-4 years of relevant experience from a consultancy, agency, or an in-house strategy, marketing, insights, or commercial function. You know how to structure a problem, work independently with analysis and strategic deliverables, and communicate your thinking clearly – while still being eager to learn from experienced colleagues and take on increasing responsibility.

Depending on your experience, you’ll either own key parts of our projects or take the lead on workstreams and day-to-day client contact.

At Sunrise, you will be part of a social, ambitious, and informal organization where you’ll work closely with consultants, specialists, project managers, and partners – with direct client exposure and responsibility from day one.

Your tasks will include

• Conducting and driving desk research, market analysis, competitor analysis, and qualitative and quantitative insights gathering

• Turning complex data, research, and customer insights into clear conclusions and strategic recommendations

• Challenging our clients’ business issues and identifying untapped potential across their commercial activities

• Developing strategies within areas such as positioning, commercial, branding, customer insights, communication, and marketing

• Contributing to and independently owning parts of client projects and strategic deliverables, and driving client engagements and workstreams independently (or with the ambition to gradually take on this responsibility)

• Preparing, facilitating and presenting at client meetings and workshops

• Translating strategic recommendations into clear input and briefs for our creative teams and Activation specialists across areas such as content, SoMe, Web, CRM, and campaigns

• Developing compelling presentations in Keynote/PowerPoint for existing and potential clients

• Contributing to and co-owning new business development through research, identification of opportunities, development of proposals, and pitches

• Planning and managing research projects with external partners (qual/quant)

Your profile

• You have 2-4 years of relevant professional experience from a consultancy, agency, or an in-house strategy, marketing, insights, branding, or commercial function

• You hold a relevant master’s degree within business administration, marketing, management, communication, or a related field

• You have a strong interest in marketing, branding, commercial strategy, customer insights, and communication

• You are analytically strong and comfortable working with both qualitative and quantitative insights – but equally importantly

• You have solid business acumen and are curious about how companies, customers, markets, and brands work – B2B experience is a benefit but not a requirement

• You are a structured problem solver who can take ownership of your own workstreams and deliverables

• You are a strategic thinker with a creative flair and enjoy moving from analysis to ideas and solutions

• You are a strong team player who enjoys collaborating across different disciplines and personalities

• You are eager to take responsibility, learn quickly, and continuously develop your consulting toolbox

• You are fluent in Danish and highly proficient in English

• It is a plus if you have experience in facilitating workshops and presenting to senior stakeholders

• It is a plus if you are interested in and have strong skillset within various AI tools and want to take a leading role in challenging existing processes from this point of view

We offer

• A steep learning curve with increasing responsibility and client exposure

• A clear path towards senior roles, and real influence on how we develop our methods and offering

• The opportunity to work with leading Danish and international companies across industries

• Personal and professional development with close sparring from experienced consultants and partners

• Exposure to projects spanning insights, commercial strategy, positioning, branding, communication, and marketing

• The opportunity to follow projects all the way from analysis and strategy to creative development and activation or actionable business initiatives

• An ambitious and personalized development path with long-term career opportunities at Sunrise

• A social, informal, and ambitious work environment in Copenhagen

About Sunrise TcTa

Sunrise TcTa isn’t a large conglomerate with standardised processes. We’re a privately owned commercial transition agency based in Copenhagen – independent and built to develop tailor-made strategic and creative solutions across industries, mostly B2B and often with an international footprint.

We’re a team of 30+ advisors, strategists, creatives, project managers, and specialists working closely together to help companies navigate change and unlock commercial growth – all while having a lot of fun along the way. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves: expect an open culture where every voice is heard, music in the office, plenty of laughter, and a calendar with social events and celebrations.

We combine customer and market insights, strategy, creativity, and activation – allowing us to move from identifying the commercial challenge to developing the strategic direction and bringing it to life.

Our ambition level is high, our pace is fast, and our structure is deliberately informal. You’ll work closely with experienced colleagues and partners, get responsibility early, and have the opportunity to make a visible impact on both our clients’ businesses and Sunrise itself.

Transitions are never easy.

But they’re often necessary.

Join us in working with the commercial ones.

Sunrise TcTa – Brand, Marketing & Commercial Strategy.

How to apply

Submit the form below. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible. We look forward to receiving your CV and motivational letter.

Job Description:

Are you a skilled and detail-oriented tester with a passion for delivering high-quality digital solutions?

At Satair, we are looking for a Backend API Automation Tester who will ensure our e-commerce platform and underlying services meet the highest standards of functionality, performance, and reliability. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on building robust automation frameworks and ensuring that the "engine" of our digital ecosystem is flawless.

The position will be located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

What The Job Is...

You'll play a crucial role in shaping the quality of our platform by leveraging your expertise in backend automation, security validation, and defect analysis. You will work closely with developers, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure our backend services are scalable and resilient, contributing directly to our mission of delivering seamless customer experience.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks specifically for backend services and APIs.

• API Automation: Create and execute sophisticated API tests using Playwright .Security & Auth: Automate complex authentication flows, including OAuth, JWT, and API keys, to ensure secure service-to-service communication.

• Validation: Validate RESTful (and SOAP) APIs for functionality, performance, and schema integrity (JSON/XML).

• CI/CD Integration: Implement and manage automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to enable continuous quality.

• Defect Management: Analyze test results, identify root causes of defects, and collaborate with developers to ensure timely resolutions.

• Strategy & Documentation: Develop comprehensive test cases, test plans, and data strategies for backend systems, ensuring high test coverage and clear API documentation.

• Full Lifecycle Testing: Conduct regression, smoke and integration testing to support frequent production releases.

How You Will Contribute To The Team

• Technical Expertise: 5-7 years of experience in backend/API testing with deep hands-on experience in Playwright.

• Scripting Skills: Proficiency in automation scripting using JavaScript or TypeScript.

• Protocol Mastery: Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, headers, status codes and version control (Git).

• Agile Knowledge: Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, Jira and modern test management tools like XRAY, HP ALM, Practi Test.

• Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to identifying bottlenecks and optimizing automation frameworks for speed and reliability.

• Stakeholder Acumen: Strong communication skills to bridge the gap between technical backend requirements and business needs.

• Collaboration: Ability to work within diverse teams and foster a positive, solutions-oriented environment.

Nice to Have

• Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or K6.

• ISTQB Foundation Certification.

• Experience with E-commerce platform architectures.

Help shape a more efficient and resilient global vaccine distribution network

Can you turn complex logistics data into practical improvements?

Do you know how to challenge transport flows, strengthen supplier performance and uncover what drives distribution costs?

And would you like to build capabilities that continue to make a difference beyond your assignment?

At Bavarian Nordic, we are looking for a Global Distribution Network Optimization Lead to improve our global distribution network and strengthen the tools, insights and ways of working behind it.

This position is initially established for approximately 12–18 months to deliver priority network improvements and build a lasting capability within Global Distribution & Logistics.

**Your role

**You will assess how our distribution network performs today and identify how it can better balance cost, service, lead time, capacity and resilience. Turning network data and operational insights into a prioritized roadmap, you will work with colleagues and logistics partners to put agreed improvements into practice.

You will report to the Head of Global Distribution & Logistics. The role has no direct reports, so your impact will come through your analytical expertise, project leadership and ability to create alignment across functions.

You will collaborate closely with Distribution Leads, Global Planning, Regional Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain Compliance, Quality and the I2O Process Manager, as well as logistics service providers and carriers.

**What You Will Do

**Your responsibilities will cover three connected areas:

Optimize the distribution network

• Assess the current network and develop a prioritized optimization roadmap covering cost, service, lead time, capacity and risk.

• Analyse distribution lanes, shipment profiles, routes, transport modes and network flows to identify improvement opportunities.

• Build transparency on distribution costs and cost-to-serve to support informed decisions.

• Identify opportunities for shipment consolidation, routing improvements, changes in transport mode and network redesign.

• Lead or support the implementation of agreed changes, working with Distribution Leads to turn recurring operational issues into lasting improvements.

**Strengthen supplier strategy and performance

**

• Develop logistics supplier and carrier strategies in close collaboration with Procurement.

• Establish a supplier performance framework with clear KPIs, governance, performance reviews and improvement plans.

• Support logistics tenders, supplier selection and contract optimization.

• Work with suppliers, carriers and internal stakeholders to deliver measurable improvements in cost and service.

**Build Capabilities That Last

**

• Establish analytical tools, standards and governance that make network optimization an ongoing part of how we work.

• Support future digital ways of working, including the use of transportation management systems (TMS) to improve visibility and decision support.

• Build and transfer knowledge so that colleagues can sustain and develop the capability beyond the assignment.

**What Success Looks Like

**During the assignment, you will establish a clear network optimization roadmap and a prioritized set of improvement opportunities. You will provide better visibility of distribution costs, develop practical lane and routing recommendations, and put a supplier performance framework and strategy in place.

Success will also mean implementing changes that deliver tangible improvements in cost, service and network resilience—and leaving colleagues with the tools and knowledge to continue that work.

**What You Bring

**You have strong experience in logistics, transportation, distribution or supply chain network optimization. You understand both the commercial drivers of a distribution network and the operational realities of making changes work.

**We are looking for someone with:

**

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex data into practical business decisions.

• Experience in logistics sourcing, tenders, carrier management and supplier performance management.

• A strong commercial and cost mindset, with the ability to assess trade-offs across service, lead time, capacity and risk.

• Strong project and change management skills, including the ability to move improvements from analysis into implementation.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence across functions.

**How You Work

**You combine a strategic perspective with a practical approach. You are comfortable challenging existing arrangements but take the time to understand operational needs before recommending changes.

You create clarity around opportunities, priorities and expected benefits, and bring colleagues with you through implementation. You also share your knowledge openly, helping others take ownership of new tools and ways of working.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**This is an opportunity to deliver meaningful improvements within a defined assignment while shaping how global distribution develops over the longer term. You will influence network decisions, supplier strategies and the analytical capabilities that support reliable vaccine distribution.

At Bavarian Nordic, we work to improve and save lives through vaccines. Our culture values persistence, openness to change and collaboration. In this role, you can put those values into practice by solving complex distribution challenges and building improvements together with colleagues across the business.

You will help shape and improve our global planning processes by identifying opportunities, challenging existing ways of working, and translating best practices into scalable solutions. Working closely with stakeholders across Global Supply Chain, you will connect global standards and strategy with effective local execution.

This is more than an analytical role. You will act as a key driver of planning excellence, helping build best-in-class planning processes and enabling smarter, more efficient and resilient ways of working across our global operations.

****Your mission is to improve our global planning landscape through process excellence, data-driven insights and effective change implementation.

****More Specifically, Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

Process Excellence: Assess and continuously improve global planning processes, identifying opportunities to increase efficiency, standardization and scalability across regions.

• 
Change & Implementation: Lead and support implementation of new processes, tools and best practices, ensuring effective adoption and sustainable change across the orgnization.

• 
Stakeholder Partnership: Partner closely with stakeholders across Global Supply Chain to align local execution with global planning standards, processes, and strategic priorities.

• 
Data & Insights: Transform complex planning data into clear, actionable insights that support global decision-making and improve cost, service and operational performance.

• 
Have 5-7+ years of experience within supply chain planning, planning excellence, process improvement, supply chain analytics, S&OP/IBP, or related areas.

•
